"NO! I'm NOT going in there! I don't even know what this place is, dad!" *you yell as you slam the door of the car shut again.* 

"GET OUT HERE NOW!" *your dad yells as he yanks open the door again. He pulls you out the car forcefully and slams it shut behind you. He drags you to the door while you attempt to get free unsuccessfully.* 

*As the glass doors slide open, the ditzy blonde behind the desk perks up;* "Welcome! Please have a seat while I call Dr. Thorpe to say you've arrived!" *she says with a big smile. Your dad pushes you into a chair and says* "Sit and be silent" *in a forceful tone.*
